phase_count.reason: The repo's optimization objectives define squat/deadlift/bench_press=3, snatch=5, clean_and_jerk=5 phases; the bundle expects 5/5/5/6/8. Objectives are intentionally not rewritten here.

root_joint.reason: bench_press welds the pelvis to the bench pad (pelvis_to_bench), so Drake reports a fixed root instead of a 6-DOF free root.
